verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships an official Python Connector SDK for building and deploying custom connectors. It also offers AI coding-agent plugins for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Copilot CLI to build, test and deploy with that SDK. Account and pipeline management, however, is exposed only as a REST API with a downloadable OpenAPI spec, and no official client SDKs are evidenced. missing for 10: official client SDKs for the REST/management API, multi-language SDK coverage beyond Python connector development, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Fivetran’s Connector SDK allows you to develop a custom data connector using Python and deploy it as an extension of Fivetran.

We provide AI coding agent plugins that add Connector SDK-specific skills to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI. These skills let you build, test, and deploy connectors using natural language prompts.
visit our Connector SDK GitHub Repo to create a custom source connector and connect it with your destination using Fivetran.
